mentions.name: A Dungeon (mega-dungeon 2026 project)
mentions.description: A year-long creative project building a mega-dungeon for tabletop roleplaying games, adding a new room each day to reach 12 levels of roughly 30 rooms per level. All dungeon tiles are created with the author's own tools, with a focus on OSR and Shadowrun play.
mentions.source_excerpt: It's a creative project in which I add a new room to a mega-dungeon over the course of a year, resulting in 12 levels and approximately 30 rooms per level at the end. All the tiles are created by me using my own tools.
